name: engine_cap_refuses_smart_order
approved_by: the command center, item task-native-agent-stack-5f-20261006T155009Z (N4): a dated addendum to #754's frozen criteria; it adds a stricter check and loosens none of C1-C4

base_criteria.unchanged: C1-C4, bounds, instrument, client_ids, session, data, timeouts, exec_tester and end_disposition apply as frozen; C5 changes none of them

setup.only_difference_from_base: LiveRiskEngineConfig.max_notional_per_order for SPY=STK.SMART is 100 USD in the C5 node run; every other parameter is the base plan's

order.price: C1's rule: bid minus floor(0.5 * admitted_bid / 0.01) ticks, about half the bid; non-marketable
order.precondition: the runner computes the order's notional before it reaches the engine; if notional <= 100 USD (a bid below about 200 USD), C5 is refused (exit 3) and never counted as passed

pass_all: the engine emits OrderDenied for the C5 client order id with reason NotionalExceedsMaxPerOrder, as rc6 renders it
no OrderSubmitted, OrderAccepted, venue OrderRejected or venue order id exists for that client order id
the check client (92) sees no open order and no execution for the C5 order at the end

fail.if_the_order_reached_the_venue: cancel it at once by client order id through the check client; the GTD 7-minute expiry is the backstop; record FAIL
fail.consequence: the rc6 pointer does not move; the IBKR paper lane stays on rc5

sequence: C5 runs first, in its own node run, in the slot 10-07 13:45-20:00Z. C1-C4 run on rc6 only after C5 passes. A C5 failure ends the slot.
receipt: the base receipt form, plus: the configured cap, the order notional, the OrderDenied event with its reason string, the three absence proofs, the engine commit and this file's sha256
limits: one paper LIMIT BUY opening order on one instrument: the cap is proven on this route for that order class only
market orders are exercised by C3 under the base 1000 USD cap, not by C5
full position exits are exempt from the per-order cap by design (mod.rs:2359); C4 is unaffected
